refutations.claim: Live-but-unwired hook window (M-04 class) at indices 1/2/3 (and 7) causes revert/DoS or mints phUSD to a zero recipient
refutations.evidence: UniboostMintDebtHook.onDispatch and NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.onDispatch only do `mintDebt += added`, gated to `dispatcher`; they never read `recipient` and never mint at dispatch time (recipient is used only by pull()). A mint in the window succeeds: prime charged, debt accrued to the hook ledger, NFT minted. Debt is fully recoverable once the staker is wired and pull() runs. The index-7 NudgeRatchetDelayRelease._dispatch hookTypeId guard is satisfied BEFORE replaceDispatcher(7) (setHook precedes replace), so no _dispatch revert. Unlike yield-claim-nft M-04 (which reverted on a wrong/absent hook), this window is non-reverting and loss-free.

refutations.claim: Off-chain patcher positionally mis-maps CREATE txs (EYE/SCX/FLX)
refutations.evidence: Patcher matches CREATE txs by contractName, consuming first-unseen in order. Script deploy order is EYE->SCX->FLX for Uniboost (Phase1), UniboostMintDebtHook (Phase1), and NFTStakerDepletion (Phase3); DEPLOY_ORDER lists each repeated name EYE->SCX->FLX. Interleaved MultiPooler doesn't affect name-scoped matching. DefaultDispatchHooks created inside dispatcher ctors are internal (additionalContracts), not top-level CREATE txs, so they don't shift positions. Abort guards correct (exit2 progress!=completed, exit4 collision/field-missing, exit3 missing CREATE). mainnet-addresses.ts confirmed: 10 zero placeholders + 2 live ratchet keys, 55 keys total.

Both OLD NudgeRatchet and NEW NudgeRatchetDelayRelease are USDC-6dp-primed (ctor requires decimals()==6). Live configs(7)=70e6/0 is valid 6-dp USDC. Leaving it untouched is correct; the reprice was only needed for 1/2/3 (old burners were target-token-18dp).

refutations.claim: The Uniboost config produces unbacked/over-minted phUSD
refutations.evidence: Per 10 USDC mint: hook accrues 5 phUSD (ratio 50), Uniboost donates 5 USDC to LSP + retains 5 USDC (POL). 10 USDC backs 5 phUSD => >=2:1 over-backing (consistent with yield-claim-nft run-13 Tier-3). NudgeRatchetDelayRelease debt/release decoupling is documented accepted design; conserves backing.
